paragraphs.text: After school, Mia reads a book outside. Sam and the dog play with a ball. Dad opens the front door. ‘Mia, there is a call for you,’ he says. Mia runs inside.
It is Anna. ‘I have a dog,’ Anna says. ‘His name is Max. He has a red collar with a blue star.’ ‘Max is here,’ she says. ‘Can you come to our house?’ Anna says yes.
Mia tells Sam. The ball is on the grass, but the dog is not there. The gate is open. Sam looks around. ‘Max!’ he calls. There is no answer. Mia is afraid.
